Map out an automated client onboarding workflow for my business. Currently, when I sign a new client, I manually: [describe your current onboarding steps — e.g., "send a welcome email, create a project in Asana, set up a Slack channel, schedule a kickoff call, send a questionnaire, collect assets, send first invoice"].
Design an automated version: (1) Trigger — what kicks off the automation (e.g., contract signed in [tool], payment received, form submitted), (2) Step-by-step automated sequence — what happens automatically, what needs human touch, (3) Tools needed for each step (suggest specific tools — Zapier, Make, native integrations), (4) Email templates for each automated message, (5) Timeline — when each step happens (Day 0, Day 1, Day 3, etc.), (6) Fallback — what happens if something breaks, (7) Estimated setup time and cost. If possible, frame this as a Zapier/Make workflow with specific trigger > action sequences.
